script_text: The animal in your dreams is not your zodiac sign—but listen to this sky story. Spirit Animals have no actual ruling planet or element in Western astrology. In career and money, innovative tools could reshape priorities around 10th House ambitions and 2nd House income; actual placements require your birth chart. The shadow is treating every animal encounter as fate. Chiron symbolizes wounds, while Retrograde symbolism invites reconsideration: neither proves an animal carries your karmic instructions. During this transit, review one relationship agreement and investigate the cost of one professional tool. Comment your sign and your recurring dream animal.
